content.rendered:
The 2017 Fun Run total raised was $72, 918.00! Thank you families, friends and sponsors for making this event so successful. Mrs. Nelson’s class brought in the most money and will be creating class t-shirts at the Adam’s Screen Print field trip. The following is the event calendar for the Fun Run prizes:

FUN RUN PRIZE DATES:

Wacky Hair Day – ($25 and over) – Tuesday, October 17th

Cinch Sack & Hat Day ($50 and over) – Tuesday, October 24th

After School Dance Party ($250 and over) -Thursday, November 9th, 2:15 – 3:30 pm,

Cafeteria (Students received an invitation. Watch for an email asking for after party plan.)

Safari Sam’s Party ($400 and over) – 11/13 – K – 2nd grades & 11/14 – 3rd – 5th gr. – (10:45 am – 1:15 pm)

(Parents will be contacted. Winners may invite 1 friend.)
